WHY VENDORED: PR #14355 is an unreviewed DRAFT (0 reviews, 2 comments as of
2026-08-03) and is modular-blocks-only -- there is no MiniMaxH3Pipeline class.
No released diffusers ships MiniMax-H3, and UniRL's floor is diffusers>=0.38.0.
Pinning the git branch was rejected: it collides with the sglang[diffusion]
diffusers override already in pyproject.toml, and the branch will rebase.
EXPECT API CHURN -- this is a draft; re-sync against a later head before
trusting parity numbers.

Files (upstream path under src/diffusers/ -> vendor file):
  schedulers/scheduling_minimax_h3.py                    -> scheduling_minimax_h3.py
  models/transformers/transformer_minimax_h3.py          -> transformer_minimax_h3.py
  models/autoencoders/autoencoder_kl_minimax_h3.py       -> autoencoder_kl_minimax_h3.py
  models/autoencoders/autoencoder_kl_minimax_h3_audio.py -> autoencoder_kl_minimax_h3_audio.py
  modular_pipelines/minimax_h3/packing.py                -> packing.py

NOT vendored (deliberate):
  modular_pipelines/minimax_h3/{before_denoise,before_encoder,denoise,
  decoders,encoders,modular_blocks_minimax_h3,modular_pipeline}.py -- UniRL's
  Pipeline/Stage classes reimplement the block graph (the blocks are
  @torch.no_grad and batch-1 orchestration; RL needs the grad path and UniRL's
  own trajectory/replay bookkeeping).
  packing_ref2va.py -- ref2va is Track C, out of scope for t2va.
  scripts/convert_minimax_h3_to_diffusers.py -- the HF repo ships already
  converted (modular_model_index.json is present upstream).

Mechanical changes (the ONLY edits; no functional change to forward math):
  1. relative -> absolute diffusers imports, by original package depth:
       scheduling_minimax_h3.py:      ..X -> diffusers.X
                                       .scheduling_utils -> diffusers.schedulers.scheduling_utils
       transformer_minimax_h3.py:     ...X -> diffusers.X ; ..X -> diffusers.models.X
       autoencoder_kl_minimax_h3*.py: ...X -> diffusers.X ; ..X -> diffusers.models.X
                                       .vae -> diffusers.models.autoencoders.vae
       packing.py:                    ...utils.torch_utils -> diffusers.utils.torch_utils
     Applied by scratchpad/vendorize.py; the script asserts no `from .`
     survives. Re-runnable on a new head.

VERIFIED at vendor time: all five modules import cleanly against the installed
diffusers 0.38.0 (apply_lora_scale, AttentionMixin/AttentionModuleMixin,
AutoencoderMixin, dispatch_attention_fn all resolve). Import-only -- NO
numerical parity has been run yet (needs the checkpoint on a GPU pod).

CHECKPOINT CONTRACTS worth re-checking on re-vendor (they drive UniRL code):
  - MINIMAX_H3_{VIDEO,TEXT,AUDIO}_TAG = 0/1/2 index the AdaLN table.
  - Row order is [text | keyframe cond | target audio | target video].
  - position_ids are FLOAT64 (video+audio share one 40-unit/s rotary clock).
  - Text rows INHERIT THE VIDEO TIMESTEP (they never reach an output head).
  - Velocity is DATA-ward: x0 = x_t + sigma*v (opposite of diffusers).
  - Timesteps are t = 1 - sigma, unscaled, t=1 == clean.
  - transformer._keep_in_fp32_modules: proj_in, audio_proj_in, time_embedder,
    proj_out, audio_proj_out, rope -- H3 is a MIXED-DTYPE checkpoint.

To re-vendor a newer head:
  1. bump SHA in scratchpad/vendorize.py's fetch step, re-fetch the 5 files
  2. python3 vendorize.py   (rewrites imports, asserts none left relative)
  3. bump this file
  4. re-run the ODE parity gate + the diffuse<->replay ratio==1 check
